verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents a built-in FastAPI Swagger surface at /docs on a self-hosted instance. It is available only when ENV=dev and is labelled experimental. Probes of the vendor docs site found no downloadable openapi.json or swagger.json (all 404), so getting a spec means running your own instance in dev mode. missing for 10: a vendor-hosted downloadable OpenAPI file, explicit documentation of a raw spec download path (beyond the Swagger UI), availability without dev mode, a stable non-experimental spec, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Make sure to set the `ENV` environment variable to `dev` in order to access the Swagger documentation
Access detailed API documentation for different services provided by Open WebUI
